name: Barovian Dire Wolf
biography: Barovian dire wolves are Strahd's loyal servants. They cannot be charmed or frightened.

items.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
items.description: The dire wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.description: The dire wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

items.name: Bite
items.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
